ٱقْتَرَبَتِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ وَٱنشَقَّ ٱلْقَمَرُ
وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ ءَايَةًۭ يُعْرِضُوا۟ وَيَقُولُوا۟ سِحْرٌۭ مُّسْتَمِرٌّۭ
وَكَذَّبُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ ۚ وَكُلُّ أَمْرٍۢ مُّسْتَقِرٌّۭ
وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَنۢبَآءِ مَا فِيهِ مُزْدَجَرٌ
حِكْمَةٌۢ بَٰلِغَةٌۭ ۖ فَمَا تُغْنِ ٱلنُّذُرُ
فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ ۘ يَوْمَ يَدْعُ ٱلدَّاعِ إِلَىٰ شَىْءٍۢ نُّكُرٍ
خُشَّعًا أَبْصَٰرُهُمْ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ كَأَنَّهُمْ جَرَادٌۭ مُّنتَشِرٌۭ
مُّهْطِعِينَ إِلَى ٱلدَّاعِ ۖ يَقُولُ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَسِرٌۭ
۞ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍۢ فَكَذَّبُوا۟ عَبْدَنَا وَقَالُوا۟ مَجْنُونٌۭ وَٱزْدُجِرَ
فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَغْلُوبٌۭ فَٱنتَصِرْ
فَفَتَحْنَآ أَبْوَٰبَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَآءٍۢ مُّنْهَمِرٍۢ
وَفَجَّرْنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ عُيُونًۭا فَٱلْتَقَى ٱلْمَآءُ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرٍۢ قَدْ قُدِرَ
وَحَمَلْنَٰهُ عَلَىٰ ذَاتِ أَلْوَٰحٍۢ وَدُسُرٍۢ
تَجْرِى بِأَعْيُنِنَا جَزَآءًۭ لِّمَن كَانَ كُفِرَ
وَلَقَد تَّرَكْنَٰهَآ ءَايَةًۭ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌۭ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًۭا صَرْصَرًۭا فِى يَوْمِ نَحْسٍۢ مُّسْتَمِرٍّۢ
تَنزِعُ ٱلنَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍۢ مُّنقَعِرٍۢ
فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَبَشَرًۭا مِّنَّا وَٰحِدًۭا نَّتَّبِعُهُۥٓ إِنَّآ إِذًۭا لَّفِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ وَسُعُرٍ
أَءُلْقِىَ ٱلذِّكْرُ عَلَيْهِ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرٌۭ
سَيَعْلَمُونَ غَدًۭا مَّنِ ٱلْكَذَّابُ ٱلْأَشِرُ
إِنَّا مُرْسِلُوا۟ ٱلنَّاقَةِ فِتْنَةًۭ لَّهُمْ فَٱرْتَقِبْهُمْ وَٱصْطَبِرْ
وَنَبِّئْهُمْ أَنَّ ٱلْمَآءَ قِسْمَةٌۢ بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ كُلُّ شِرْبٍۢ مُّحْتَضَرٌۭ
فَنَادَوْا۟ صَاحِبَهُمْ فَتَعَاطَىٰ فَعَقَرَ
فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ فَكَانُوا۟ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلْمُحْتَظِرِ
وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍۭ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حَاصِبًا إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ نَّجَّيْنَٰهُم بِسَحَرٍۢ
نِّعْمَةًۭ مِّنْ عِندِنَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى مَن شَكَرَ
وَلَقَدْ أَنذَرَهُم بَطْشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوْا۟ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
وَلَقَدْ رَٰوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيْفِهِۦ فَطَمَسْنَآ أَعْيُنَهُمْ فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
وَلَقَدْ صَبَّحَهُم بُكْرَةً عَذَابٌۭ مُّسْتَقِرٌّۭ
فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
وَلَقَدْ جَآءَ ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ ٱلنُّذُرُ
كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذْنَٰهُمْ أَخْذَ عَزِيزٍۢ مُّقْتَدِرٍ

أَمْ يَقُولُونَ نَحْنُ جَمِيعٌۭ مُّنتَصِرٌۭ
سَيُهْزَمُ ٱلْجَمْعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ ٱلدُّبُرَ
بَلِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدْهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ
إِنَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ وَسُعُرٍۢ

إِنَّا كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَٰهُ بِقَدَرٍۢ
وَمَآ أَمْرُنَآ إِلَّا وَٰحِدَةٌۭ كَلَمْحٍۭ بِٱلْبَصَرِ
وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَآ أَشْيَاعَكُمْ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
وَكُلُّ شَىْءٍۢ فَعَلُوهُ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
وَكُلُّ صَغِيرٍۢ وَكَبِيرٍۢ مُّسْتَطَرٌ
إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَنَهَرٍۢ
فِى مَقْعَدِ صِدْقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكٍۢ مُّقْتَدِرٍۭ

parent_channels.name: P1 - Controlled Release and Conveyance

subchannels.name: Upper reservoir opens
subchannels.scene_or_process: Closed overhead gates open and discharge a sustained torrent.

subchannels.synthesis: The sky is construed as a sealed reservoir whose gates are deliberately opened into a continuous discharge.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A bounded substance is released through an aperture, gathered to a measured course, and carried in a fitted conveyance.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: An animal hide becomes a reliable water vessel through removal, joining, fine stitching, seasoning, and leak control.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 54:1, 54:7, 54:12, 54:14, 54:28-29, 54:34, 54:37, 54:50, and 54:53 carry the roots for proximity, sight, drinking, companionship, rescue, and smallness.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The craft materializes the difference between possessing water and controlling access to it: portable provision depends on carefully maintained boundaries, whereas the flood opens boundaries and the final rivers flow without scarcity.

parent_channels.name: Whole-surah - Palm Growth and Harvest Residue

subchannels.name: Rain revives ground into a flowering palm stand
subchannels.scene_or_process: Soft fertile ground receives moisture, dry pasture greens again, young palms establish themselves, and mature trees flower.
subchannels.active_motifs: soft fertile soil `quranic:root_000025:B002/m01`; dry pasture revived by rain `quranic:root_001503:B004/m01`; young palm shoots `quranic:root_000831:B008/m01`; palm tree `quranic:root_001483:B001/m01`; flowering tree `quranic:root_001564:B004/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: This growth sequence provides the positive process absent from the uprooted trunks and brittle brush. It reframes the final gardens as life maintained through every stage, not merely a static reward landscape.

subchannels.name: Ripened fruit is cut and leaves dry gleanings
subchannels.scene_or_process: Fruit remains covered while it fills and ripens, then the palm crop is cut, leaving fallen dates, kernels, and dry remnants for gleaning.
subchannels.active_motifs: sheath covering fruit or palm spathe `quranic:root_001307:B010/m01`; fruit filling and ripening with moisture `quranic:root_001458:B006/m01`; cutting and harvesting palm fruit `quranic:root_000239:B001/m01`; fallen or dried harvest remnants `quranic:root_000239:B002/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The harvest scene makes cutting produce a visible remainder. It usefully pressures the judgment imagery: the communities compared with uprooted palms and crushed brush are not gathered as fruit but left as the residue by which a later people can recognize what occurred.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Cultivated life moves from wetted ground and new growth through flowering and ripening to cutting and residual gleanings.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 54:7, 54:12, 54:20, 54:47-49, 54:52, and 54:54 carry the earth, spreading, palm, crime, water, fire, and garden roots.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The full cultivation cycle turns the surah's plant images into outcomes rather than decoration: protected growth culminates in gardens, while judged communities are interrupted at the cutting and residue stages.

parent_channels.name: S1. P1 - Desire tracks itself into a settled outcome
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Denial follows inward inclination step by step until each affair reaches a fixed terminus.
parent_channels.active_motifs: follow or track `quranic:root_000175:B001/m03`; trace step by step `quranic:root_000175:B003/m01`; inward desire `quranic:root_001609:B004/m01`; affair or state `quranic:root_000051:B001/m01`; settle or stabilize `quranic:root_001215:B003/m02`.
parent_channels.synthesis: The verse links subjective inclination to objective arrival: repeated following hardens desire into destination.

parent_channels.name: S2. P1 - The moon becomes a wagered token
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A lunar sign is drawn into the semantic world of gaming lots, risky gain, and the case that holds divining arrows.
parent_channels.active_motifs: moon and lunar light `quranic:root_001255:B001/m01`; gambling and deceptive win `quranic:root_001255:B007/m01`; gaming lots and divided carcass `quranic:root_001694:B007/m01`; leather case for gaming arrows `quranic:root_000532:B010/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: The sign pressures spectatorship into decision: what is treated as visual marvel also behaves like a cast lot whose outcome exposes the player.

parent_channels.name: S3. P2 - The responsive bow
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Separation between bow and string is overcome by drawing, pliancy, and compliant return.
parent_channels.active_motifs: bowstring separated from the bow's belly `quranic:root_000170:B008/m01`; smooth pliant motion `quranic:root_000563:B003/m01`; compliance after resistance `quranic:root_000844:B003/m01`; pliant bow `quranic:root_001028:B006/m01`; draw a bowstring `quranic:root_001489:B002/m01`; light responsive movement `quranic:root_001694:B005/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: The interval's sending, pulling, companionship, and response cohere as a tensioned instrument whose stored force is released through compliance.

parent_channels.name: S4. P2 - The trial becomes a bitter draught
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A regulated drinking turn is violated and changes from potable provision into a biting medicinal-punitive dose.
parent_channels.active_motifs: drink liquid `quranic:root_000783:B001/m01`; drinking allotment `quranic:root_000783:B002/m02`; bitter aloe medicine `quranic:root_000840:B008/m01`; drug that bites the body or gut `quranic:root_001035:B008/m01`; bitterness `quranic:root_001414:B003/m01`; punishment `quranic:root_000994:B005/m04`.
parent_channels.synthesis: Once the shared drink is violated, the semantic channel turns ingestion into correction: what should sustain becomes a dose whose bitterness cannot be refused.

parent_channels.name: S5. P2 - Warning recurs as readable cycle
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Denial, punishment, warning, recitation, and remembrance recur in a deliberately reopened sequence.
parent_channels.active_motifs: return or recurrence `quranic:root_001058:B001/m01`; event becoming `quranic:root_001332:B001/m01`; punishment `quranic:root_000994:B005/m05`; warning that awakens caution `quranic:root_001488:B001/m03`; easing and opening `quranic:root_001694:B001/m02`; reading or recitation `quranic:root_001210:B002/m02`; reminder-token `quranic:root_000516:B009/m02`.
parent_channels.synthesis: Repetition is functional rather than ornamental: each historical cycle is reopened as a readable warning in the present.

parent_channels.name: S6. P3 - Total denial meets total capture
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Comprehensive denial of signs is answered by seizure that combines accountability, capture, might, and capacity.
parent_channels.active_motifs: accuse of lying `quranic:root_001290:B002/m03`; visible sign `quranic:root_000074:B003/m02`; totality `quranic:root_001315:B003/m04`; grasp or take `quranic:root_000018:B001/m01`; take to account `quranic:root_000018:B002/m01`; capture `quranic:root_000018:B003/m01`; invincible might `quranic:root_001008:B001/m01`; overpower `quranic:root_001008:B002/m01`; power or capacity `quranic:root_001205:B003/m02`.
parent_channels.synthesis: The repeated totalizers are matched: denial excludes every sign, and capture closes every avenue of escape.

parent_channels.name: S7. P4 - Destroyed predecessors become a transmitted warning
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Earlier allied groups fall, leaving a precedent that later counterparts can retrieve as admonition.
parent_channels.active_motifs: destruction or fall `quranic:root_001596:B001/m01`; successors or following groups `quranic:root_000836:B001/m01`; allied faction `quranic:root_000836:B002/m01`; counterpart `quranic:root_000836:B007/m01`; entity or thing `quranic:root_000831:B001/m03`; recall `quranic:root_000516:B003/m02`; reminder-token `quranic:root_000516:B009/m03`.
parent_channels.synthesis: Destruction acquires prospective force when a later faction recognizes itself as the counterpart of an earlier one.

parent_channels.name: S8. Whole-surah - Moonlit falcon ambush
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A hunter goes out under moonlight, sits concealed behind a shooting blind, and uses an owl decoy to draw a sharp falcon within reach.
parent_channels.active_motifs: hunting by moonlight `quranic:root_001255:B003/m01`; going out to hunt `quranic:root_000745:B006/m01`; hunter's shooting blind `quranic:root_000584:B011/m01`; seated ambush `quranic:root_001244:B005/m01`; predatory falcon or hawk `quranic:root_001040:B006/m01`; sharp falcon `quranic:root_001375:B006/m01`; owl decoy used to lure a falcon `quranic:root_001384:B008/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: The complete ambush scene materializes the surah's watching and sudden-seizure language as a patient hunt: people who assume the observer's position by inspecting and dismissing signs are themselves already watched, and the final command closes with a falcon-like flash.

parent_channels.name: S9. Whole-surah - Stone-lined well and hand-drawn basin
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A shaft is entered and excavated, cut to hold water, lined with stone, and either abandoned dry or worked until water can be drawn by hand into a basin.
parent_channels.active_motifs: entering deep into the ground `quranic:root_000950:B006/m01`; newly cut pit or well that holds water `quranic:root_000434:B011/m01`; lining a well with stones `quranic:root_000621:B001/m01`; well abandoned before reaching water `quranic:root_001244:B015/m01`; water drawn by hand or suspended bucket `quranic:root_001489:B008/m01`; basin or kneading trough `quranic:root_001245:B007/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: This work scene materializes the surah's water episodes as regimes of access: floodwater is released beyond human control, trial-water is apportioned, and garden-water flows openly, while the well shows hidden provision becoming usable only through measured excavation, lining, and drawing.

parent_channels.name: S10. Whole-surah - Bridle, rein, and digging gallop
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A rider checks a horse with the bit, lets out the rein to increase speed, moves through a controlled approach gait, and drives into a hoof-digging gallop that can still veer off line.
parent_channels.active_motifs: restraining bit around the horse's jaws `quranic:root_000348:B006/m01`; rider extending the rein to increase speed `quranic:root_000151:B007/m01`; controlled approach gait `quranic:root_001212:B014/m01`; animal brought into a gallop `quranic:root_000333:B004/m01`; hoof-digging horse run `quranic:root_001599:B005/m01`; horse sidling and resisting a straight line `quranic:root_001001:B012/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: The equestrian sequence materializes directed speed: release of rein accelerates motion, but bit and line still govern it. That usefully reframes both the rush toward the caller and the defeated army's turn as bodies driven into trajectories they do not finally control.

parent_channels.name: S11. Whole-surah - Prosodist scanning a line
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A line is modeled on an established poetic pattern, weighed in prosodic meter, monitored at alternating positions, directed toward its rhyme, and checked for a metrical defect.
parent_channels.active_motifs: poetic model and pattern `quranic:root_001211:B005/m01`; prosodic meter `quranic:root_001001:B014/m01`; monitoring alternating prosodic letters `quranic:root_000584:B014/m01`; directing the rhyme `quranic:root_001630:B011/m01`; metrical defect in a verse `quranic:root_001244:B017/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: Without reducing recitation to poetry, this technical practice materializes how recurrence can be fitted for memory: model, meter, monitored alternation, rhyme, and defect-checking sharpen the repeated claim that the Quran has been made easy for remembrance, so the warning's recurrence is disciplined rather than loose.

parent_channels.name: S12. Whole-surah - Hidden-hand riddle game
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Players exchange a masked prompt, ask which object is concealed, bring the hand's contents into view, and confirm the answer.
parent_channels.active_motifs: riddling prompt that solicits a hidden answer `quranic:root_000478:B007/m01`; game of bringing out what is in the hand `quranic:root_000400:B010/m01`; interrogative selection of which one `quranic:root_000074:B004/m01`; affirmative answer and confirmation `quranic:root_001525:B004/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: The game usefully pressures the surah's repeated questions: its signs are not riddles whose answers may remain indefinitely concealed. History and judgment bring the hidden contents into view and force an answer to `فهل من مدكر`.

parent_channels.name: S13. Whole-surah - Deathbed, burial, and estate
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Illness or death overpowers a person, the dying struggle passes into release, the body is concealed, and property and social position remain to descendants or kin.
parent_channels.active_motifs: illness or death gaining mastery `quranic:root_001008:B009/m01`; death throes `quranic:root_001489:B016/m01`; death expressed as release or rest `quranic:root_000609:B016/m01`; burial and shrouding of the dead `quranic:root_000266:B009/m01`; estate left by the deceased `quranic:root_000180:B006/m01`; descendant or kin left behind `quranic:root_000584:B015/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: This sequence completes the ordinary physical and social closure of a death. It materially sharpens 54:7, where emergence reverses not only bodily concealment but a settled world that has already transferred the dead person's remainder to those left behind.

parent_channels.name: S14. Whole-surah - Pilgrimage pebble station
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Travel pauses in the pre-pilgrimage month, people assemble at an appointed standing place, and the rite centers on the marked pebble-casting station.
parent_channels.active_motifs: gathering place, day, or call `quranic:root_000259:B004/m01`; collection and assembly `quranic:root_001210:B001/m01`; standing station `quranic:root_001273:B006/m01`; al-Muhassab or the place of the pebble-casting stations `quranic:root_000325:B006/m01`; Dhu al-Qadah as the month of ceasing travel before pilgrimage `quranic:root_001244:B014/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: The rite reframes the Lot scene by inversion: at pilgrimage a gathered body stands at a marked place and casts pebbles, whereas in 54:34 the gathered community receives a stone-bearing storm. The reversal turns an ordered sacred assembly into judgment.

parent_channels.name: S15. P2-P4 bridge - Rejected singularity defeats collective force
parent_channels.scene_or_process: P2 rejects one human and is ended by one cry; P3's self-assured collective breaks; P4 locates decisive efficacy in one command.
parent_channels.active_motifs: human messenger `quranic:root_000120:B002/m01`; rejected singular individual `quranic:root_001631:B001/m02`; singular destructive cry `quranic:root_001631:B001/m01`; army or collective `quranic:root_000259:B002/m01`; broken battle line `quranic:root_001590:B002/m01`; indivisible singular command `quranic:root_001631:B001/m03`; unified direction `quranic:root_001631:B005/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: The P2-P4 bridge is a role progression and singular-versus-collective reversal. Singularity first appears insufficient, then proves sufficient in cry and command, while claimed strength in numbers collapses. Efficacy belongs not to count but to the source and unified direction of the act.

parent_channels.name: S16. P1-P3 bridge - Under Our eyes, then eyes erased
parent_channels.scene_or_process: P1 places the rescued vessel under protective sight; P3 removes sight from aggressors who seek the guests.
parent_channels.active_motifs: protective oversight `quranic:root_001069:B003/m01`; eye `quranic:root_001069:B001/m01`; direct seeing `quranic:root_001069:B002/m01`; extinguished sight `quranic:root_000950:B002/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: The P1-P3 bridge is a polarity of sight: being under the divine eye marks preservation, whereas turning one's own eyes toward predation ends in the erasure of sight. The shared organ changes from an instrument of care to the site of judgment.

parent_channels.name: S17. P1-P3 bridge - Eased remembrance before the difficult Day
parent_channels.scene_or_process: P1 names the summoned Day difficult, while P1-P3 repeatedly present recitation and remembrance as made easy beforehand.
parent_channels.active_motifs: difficult day `quranic:root_001012:B001/m01`; repeated easing after difficulty `quranic:root_001694:B001/m03`; repeated recitation `quranic:root_001210:B002/m03`; repeated reminder-token `quranic:root_000516:B009/m04`.
parent_channels.synthesis: The P1-P3 bridge is a direct ease-difficulty contrast with causal pressure. Facilitated recitation offers a present route into remembrance; refusal leaves the summoned Day to be encountered as difficulty rather than as an unannounced outcome.

parent_channels.name: S18. Whole-surah - Night watcher tracks lunar stations
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A wakeful observer follows the moon through its nightly stations, watches al-Dabaran trail the Pleiades, and compares a counterpart star by opposed rising and setting.
parent_channels.active_motifs: moon entering a nightly station `quranic:root_000018:B008/m01`; wakefulness under moonlight `quranic:root_001255:B009/m01`; al-Dabaran following the Pleiades `quranic:root_000458:B013/m01`; counterpart star marked by opposed rising and setting `quranic:root_000584:B007/m01`; encircling lunar mansion or crown `quranic:root_001315:B005/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: The observing practice materializes celestial time as ordered recurrence rather than spectacle. The split moon and approaching Hour stand against a calibrated sky whose stations can be watched night by night, sharpening the claim that creation and its appointed end both proceed by measure.

parent_channels.name: S19. Whole-surah - Sawing and sealing the rescue vessel
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Wood is cut by a toothed saw, sawdust falls as boards are prepared, the planks are fastened into a hull, and the finished vessel is coated with pitch.
parent_channels.active_motifs: sawing wood with a toothed tool `quranic:root_000035:B003/m01`; sawing wood and its fallen sawdust `quranic:root_001503:B005/m01`; broad construction plank `quranic:root_001384:B003/m01`; fasteners joining ship planks `quranic:root_000474:B002/m01`; pitch-coated or tarred ship `quranic:root_000973:B005/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: The workshop supplies the production sequence behind `ذات ألواح ودسر`. Rescue is thereby materialized not as an abstract conveyance but as prepared material, waste-producing labor, structural joining, and waterproofing fitted before the waters arrive.

parent_channels.name: S20. Whole-surah - Fire assay reveals material quality
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A hard fire-striking stone kindles fuel, metal pieces are exposed to blaze for assay, and heated copper and smoke register the transformation.
parent_channels.active_motifs: hard white stone that strikes fire `quranic:root_001416:B002/m01`; fuel cast into a fire `quranic:root_000325:B004/m01`; blazing and kindling `quranic:root_000708:B001/m01`; assay of metal or person by fire `quranic:root_001128:B001/m01`; compact iron piece or lump `quranic:root_000621:B002/m01`; red copper `quranic:root_001480:B004/m01`; smoke without flame `quranic:root_001480:B005/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: The assay supplies an exact mechanism linking trial to fire: heat does not invent material quality but exposes it under pressure. This reframes the P2 test and P4 burning as successive disclosures, with final contact making inward culpability materially undeniable.

parent_channels.name: S21. Whole-surah - Written debt claim and surety
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A claimant pursues an outstanding right, produces its written instrument, seeks payment, and relies on a surety until judgment settles the obligation.
parent_channels.active_motifs: claimant pursuing a right or debt `quranic:root_000175:B005/m01`; written deed establishing a right `quranic:root_000516:B008/m01`; collection and satisfaction of debt `quranic:root_000244:B003/m01`; surety bearing liability or damages `quranic:root_000357:B004/m01`; judicial settlement between parties `quranic:root_000348:B002/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: The claim scene gives documentary force to the surah's books: writing establishes liability, a surety bears it, and judgment converts record into settlement. It therefore reverses the hope for a prior written discharge in 54:43; the operative document supports the claim rather than erasing it.

parent_channels.name: S22. Whole-surah - Market valuation fixes price and payment
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Goods enter an active market, are appraised and assigned a price, then pass through present cash, deferred credit, or resale at disclosed cost.
parent_channels.active_motifs: merchandise or worldly goods `quranic:root_001001:B008/m01`; active and circulating market `quranic:root_001273:B018/m01`; appraisal and valuation `quranic:root_001273:B010/m01`; market price `quranic:root_000708:B003/m01`; cash on hand `quranic:root_001069:B011/m01`; credit sale yielding present cash `quranic:root_001069:B012/m01`; resale at a known original price `quranic:root_001684:B014/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: Valuation turns heterogeneous goods into explicit liabilities and equivalences, materializing the surah's insistence on measure and exhaustive accounting. Yet final `سعر` is not a negotiable quotation: no collective demand, deferred payment, or resale can alter the settled reckoning.
